reforms.description: The President announced a programme aimed at increasing the share of solar power and energy from renewable resources to 20% by the year 2000, alongside the creation of an energy security corporation to direct the development of 2.5 mbd of oil substitutes from various sources by 1990.
reforms.component_name: Renewable Energy and Oil Substitutes Programme
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The initiatives aim to enhance energy security and promote renewable energy sources, which can lead to increased innovation and economic growth.
reforms.importance_rationale: These initiatives represent significant but narrower reforms aimed at enhancing energy production and security.
reforms.source_quote: In June the President announced a programme aimed at increasing the share of solar power and energy from other renewable resources from the current 6 per cent of energy consumption to 20 per cent by the year 2000.

reforms.description: The National Energy Act was passed by Congress in October 1978, introducing measures aimed at reducing energy consumption and promoting energy conservation.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The Act promotes energy conservation, which can lead to more efficient energy use and stimulate innovation in energy technologies.
reforms.status_evidence: The Act was passed by Congress.
reforms.importance_rationale: The National Energy Act represents a structural, system-wide change in energy policy.
reforms.source_quote: A National Energy Act was finally passed by Congress in October 1978.

reforms.description: In April 1979, the President announced plans to decontrol oil prices and proposed a windfall profits tax to fund an Energy Security Fund for low-income households and energy-saving investments.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The initiative aims to support low-income households and promote energy-saving investments, which can enhance overall economic efficiency.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative represents a significant reform in energy policy aimed at supporting vulnerable populations and promoting energy efficiency.
reforms.source_quote: In April 1979, the President announced that he would use this discretionary period to decontrol oil prices.
